profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Mission-driven software engineer with a service-first mindset. I build thoughtful, scalable web applications that make people’s work—and lives—a little easier.

Before tech, I spent 15 years in healthcare, where I learned how clarity, empathy, and structure can change someone’s experience. I carry those lessons into engineering—whether I’m designing front-end systems in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, or integrating APIs and data workflows in Node, NestJS, and PostgreSQL.

Recently, I’ve been exploring AI and LLM integrations to enhance automation and enrich user experience—using intelligent data enrichment and context-aware tools to make everyday workflows smarter and faster.

I’m passionate about creating technology that empowers people to work more efficiently, think more creatively, and feel supported by what they use.

💻 GitHub: github.com/chawissa

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Next.js · TypeScript · Jest · NestJS · Node.js · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
∙ Built a Chrome developer tool to record browser interactions and automatically generate Puppeteer test suites, improving testing speed and reliability
∙ Implemented Chrome Extension APIs, service workers, and Svelte UI components; used Jest for validation and Puppeteer for end-to-end testing
∙ Product developed under tech accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io)

positions.title: Bookworm | App for keeping track of books read
positions.description: ∙ Developed RESTful Node.js/Express backend with PostgreSQL and React Hooks for efficient state handling and dynamic UI updates

positions.title: Sneakers and Donuts | E-commerce site
positions.description: ∙ Built with React and TailwindCSS using reusable components and NoSQL schema for scalability and fast data retrieval

positions.title: Eatr | App that lists restaurants based on the user's location
positions.description: ∙ Built a single-page React application using React Router for dynamic routing, Redux for centralized state management, and Material-UI for consistent, responsive design

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
∙ Developed and optimized landing page layouts using HTML and CSS for usability and performance
∙ Tested UI elements (forms, buttons, navigation) before deployment to ensure responsiveness
∙ Maintained WordPress CMS systems, troubleshooting plugins and performing updates
